symbolRule: Exactly the 13 active Volatility symbols and native 1s/2s cadences in the checksum-pinned v1 protocol; do not add or remove symbols after observing results.
observedV1Failure: R_10 public history omitted scheduled epochs 1791354024 and 1791354026 in both a 1000-tick page and a focused 30-tick request. V1 remains FAILED; no row is interpolated or copied into this study.

collection.pageRule: Fetch backward from the exact UTC end; save checksum-named immutable pages separately. Permit aligned missing source timestamps, but never interpolate, forward-fill, or manufacture a tick.
collection.integrityRule: Reject malformed, out-of-window, misaligned, out-of-order, duplicate, conflicting, or checksum-invalid rows. Any symbol below 99.9% source-tick coverage is INCOMPLETE and cannot receive a strategy score.

evaluation.candidateSource: All 550 previously frozen variants from the 50-rule and additional-500 catalogs; no rule changes after seeing cross-symbol data.
evaluation.split: first 12 UTC hours and last 12 UTC hours; reset indicator state at midpoint and at each missing tick
evaluation.gapRule: No signal, delayed entry, open contract, or settlement may cross a missing tick or the midpoint.
evaluation.exploratoryScreen: At least 100 settlements in both halves for every delay, and positive modeled return in both halves for every delay at +0.70 win profit. Passing remains DEVELOPMENT_ONLY, never trading approval.
